exercises.why: **заговорил** — заговори́ть (perfective): to begin to speak; to talk someone's ear off (tire someone out by one's talk); to exorcise, to bewitch, to charm, to cast a spell, to enchant. Wiktionary: за- + говори́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **поеду** — пое́хать (perfective): to ride, to drive; to travel; (figurative) to go mad/insane, to lose one's mind. Wiktionary: по- + е́хать.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to begin to knock, to rap, etc.
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: застуча́ть — to begin to knock, to rap, etc.; забе́гать — to start running; заговори́ть — to begin to speak; пое́хать — to ride, to drive.
**поеду** — пое́хать (perfective): to ride, to drive; to travel; (figurative) to go mad/insane, to lose one's mind. Wiktionary: по- + е́хать.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **рассмеялся** — рассмея́ться (perfective): to burst out laughing, to start laughing. Wiktionary: рас- + смея́ться.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Tom was the first one to laugh.
exercises.why: **рассмеялся** — рассмея́ться (perfective): to burst out laughing, to start laughing. Wiktionary: рас- + смея́ться.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to begin to shout, to cry out, to give a shout
to start running, to break into a run
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: поползти́ — to (start) creeping, crawling; закрича́ть — to begin to shout, to cry out, to give a shout; засмея́ться — to laugh, to start laughing; побежа́ть — to start running, to break into a run.

**поплыл** — поплы́ть (perfective): to start swimming, to start floating; to start sailing; (figuratively) to hesitate or be unsure; (colloquial, slang, figuratively) to lose one's nerve. Wiktionary: по- + плыть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **поплывёт** — поплы́ть (perfective): to start swimming, to start floating; to start sailing; (figuratively) to hesitate or be unsure; (colloquial, slang, figuratively) to lose one's nerve. Wiktionary: по- + плыть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to begin to want, to begin to desire
to start singing, to sing out
to begin to tremble, to begin to shiver
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: захоте́ть — to begin to want, to begin to desire; запла́кать — to start crying, weeping; запе́ть — to start singing, to sing out; задрожа́ть — to begin to tremble, to begin to shiver.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to burst out laughing, to start laughing
to start smoking, to light up
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: рассмея́ться — to burst out laughing, to start laughing; закури́ть — to start smoking, to light up; зарабо́тать — to earn; заигра́ть — to begin to play.
